statement: Anvil Points come from three sources; first is smithing level giving 1 point per level.

creator: nocturne
statement: Anvil points can be bought with coins up to 600 points, or with monster drops for an additional 700 points.

creator: nocturne
statement: The first 25 points cost 38 spore caps, 446 frog legs and 1129 bean slices; later points need higher-level drops and more of them.

creator: nocturne
statement: On his character one point needs 1,810 high steaks from Tysons in World 2, and it gets more expensive.

statement: Points can be spent on three options; Bonus EXP is a multiplier on base exp, e.g. 94 exp per craft instead of 6.

creator: nocturne
statement: Carry Capacity only multiplies produced item amount in the anvil tab and does not affect bag carry capacity; his items had 89.9K production per hour.

statement: Highly recommends against spending points into Capacity because upgrading crafting bags raises inventory and anvil production tab capacity anyway.

creator: nocturne
statement: Best to put most points into Speed per Hour and a small amount into Bonus EXP if you want to level faster.
